artist.name: Jamie Miller
artist.short_description: Jamie Miller: an Afterglow editorial discovery candidate in pop.
artist.biography: Jamie Miller is a Welsh singer-songwriter from Cardiff who came to wider attention through The Voice UK and later established a recording career built around powerful vocals and emotionally charged pop. His breakthrough song “Here’s Your Perfect” appeared in 2021 and became a major streaming success. The singer’s official website traces subsequent releases through the Broken Memories EP, The Things I Left Unsaid EP, and the album Long Way Home, before new material in 2026. BMG documented his signing of a global recording and publishing agreement in 2023. Miller’s current official biography also emphasizes the influence of classic soul and R&B, which helps distinguish him from the softer acoustic performers in Afterglow. For the site he would provide a bridge between romantic piano-pop and larger, vocally expressive ballads. Care is needed with “Here’s Your Perfect,” which exists as the original solo recording, collaborations, acoustic interpretations, and later compilation editions. The site should link only to a verified recording and avoid silently merging those different releases.
